So I've gone to some breweries and places that provide growlers for you, and while I love collecting them some are way overpriced. I don't have any answers - just another question. But will most breweries even fill containers like that? Harpoon has some kind of crazy growler-filling contraption. Will a container like that even work in there? Even if it doesn't matter, I imagine a lot of breweries wouldn't trust an outside container - either for quality reasons (might not seal properly, etc.) or because it might not be the right volume.

It really depends on the location. I know some places (like Harpoon) will only fill their own for sanitation and preservation reasons. Some won't fill anything with other breweries logos on it. I know plenty of bars though that will fill pretty much anything you bring, as long as it's a growler. Hopefully something like that would be seen in that way.

This snip will group your sidebar buttons together, move your subverse name down (the rss feed), and move your subscriber text up. Just add to the bottom of your CSS and it should work. If it doesn't, come to /v/simplegoats and post about it. I had an issue applying it to one of my subverses, but I got it worked out.

You might have problems if you have moved other things around on the sidebar, but if you are using the default theme with my button sizing snip, this will work just like it does on this site. Without resizing the buttons, the sub/unsub and block buttons won't quite be in the right place initially, but I address that in the code.

/* Move RSS feed down */
.titlebox .hover {
 text-align: center;
 position: relative;
 top: 115px; /* if you are not using my button resize snip and using the default, this needs to be set at or around 60. */
}
/* Reset the starting point */
#container > div.side > div:nth-child(4) > div > h1 > a.hover {
 position: relative;
 top: 0px;
}
/* Move the subscribers, buttons, and online people up */
.titlebox .subscribers,
.titlebox .users-online,
.side .btn-sub,
.side .btn-unsub,
.side .btn-whoaverse-paging {
 position: relative;
 top: -30px;
}
